title: Null Run tower signature mobs: six original identities

behavior_families.latchwing: Existing class 15 CYBR family: telegraphed locked-direction dash. The design art uses it unchanged.
behavior_families.relay_choir: Existing class 16 PAIN family: anchored telegraphed slow three-projectile fan. The design art uses it unchanged.

notes: ART ONLY. Six new identities use the two existing behavior family identifiers; no new AI, actor IDs, frame mapping, projectiles or mechanics are introduced.
A and B are two structural variants of the same identity and behavior family; they are not recolours.
Every atlas is 512x768 RGBA: four columns x six rows of 128x128 cells, rows idle/walk/warn/attack/hurt/death, frame 23 a corpse.
Proposed vertical behaviour is marked unimplemented in each identity; Codex owns behavior, frame mapping, collision and visual validation.
The 128 px atlas and y=120 floor anchor follow the reviewed native mob-kit convention.

latchwing.name: CHAIN HOUND
latchwing.description: A low cast-iron bell hound: a banded drum body carried on four chain-link legs with hook feet, a bell-shaped muzzle with a loose clapper, and a counterweight tail. It reads first as foundry debris, then as an animal when the chain legs take a step.
latchwing.variant_a: Four chain legs, one bell muzzle, a short counterweight tail and a mane of five hanging links.
latchwing.variant_b: Six chain legs, a split two-cup muzzle, a longer tail with two counterweights and a heavier bronze brow.
latchwing.tells: The chain legs coil and shorten while the clapper draws back and the muzzle cup glows furnace orange. The whole body lowers before the dash.
latchwing.counterplay: The dash is locked to the direction of the lowered muzzle. Sidestep or break line of sight; do not back away in the same lane. Its flank is open during the coil.
latchwing.warning_notes: The chain legs coil and shorten while the clapper draws back and the muzzle cup glows furnace orange. The whole body lowers before the dash.
latchwing.limits: Existing latchwing family only: latchwing class 15 CYBR telegraphed locked-direction dash, or relay_choir class 16 PAIN anchored slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, actor ID or mechanics. Codex owns behavior, labels and native frame mapping.

vertical_behavior_proposal.proposal: Proposed only, not implemented: drop from a maintenance balcony to a lower gantry when the quarry is directly below, then require a full recovery pause. It cannot climb chain or ladder geometry and cannot cross a gap wider than one native tile.
requires: new navigation/ledge queries
new lift state handling where named
vertical projectile/line-of-fire checks where named
Codex review before any gameplay claim

relay_choir.name: POURING CHOIR
relay_choir.description: An anchored casting mould that has grown three crucible lips: a stack of soot-black flasks bound in bronze, with a vertical seam, three glowing pour vents and a tapping bar. It swivels on a cast base instead of walking and pours a slow three-part fan.
relay_choir.variant_a: Tall three-flask stack with lips at three heights and a narrow base.
relay_choir.variant_b: Wide cauldron body with three lips around one rim and a heavy counterweighted tapping arm.
relay_choir.tells: The three vents brighten in sequence, the tapping bar lifts and three molten beads form on the lips before they extend outward.
relay_choir.counterplay: It is anchored and turns slowly. Strafe around cover rather than retreating down its lane; the fan is slow enough to walk out of at middle range. Do not stand under a lip while it is bright.
relay_choir.warning_notes: The three vents brighten in sequence, the tapping bar lifts and three molten beads form on the lips before they extend outward.
relay_choir.limits: Existing relay_choir family only: latchwing class 15 CYBR telegraphed locked-direction dash, or relay_choir class 16 PAIN anchored slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, actor ID or mechanics. Codex owns behavior, labels and native frame mapping.

vertical_behavior_proposal.proposal: Proposed only, not implemented: its three pour streams could arc to one lower balcony and one upper rail, but that requires new projectile pitch and line-of-fire checks. Keep it floor-anchored in the first pass.
requires: new navigation/ledge queries
new lift state handling where named
vertical projectile/line-of-fire checks where named
Codex review before any gameplay claim

latchwing.name: ROOT STILT
latchwing.description: A tall, thin nursery silhouette on two bone-white root stilts. Its torso is a cage of pale ribs around a dark hollow; its head is a drooping fungal bell with a vertical slit, and its arms are loose root tendrils. It moves with a slow, deliberate step that is worse than a run.
latchwing.variant_a: Two long stilts, a narrow rib cage and one drooping bell head.
latchwing.variant_b: Three stilts, a wider split bell head and a skirt of short root tendrils around the hollow torso.
latchwing.tells: Both stilts lock straight and the rib cage flares; the head slit opens to a dark vertical line and the tendril arms go still. The step is telegraphed by a forward lean that holds for four frames.
latchwing.counterplay: The stride is a locked-direction lunge. Step out of the lane and use a growth chamber or root cage as cover; its turning is poor.
latchwing.warning_notes: Both stilts lock straight and the rib cage flares; the head slit opens to a dark vertical line and the tendril arms go still. The step is telegraphed by a forward lean that holds for four frames.
latchwing.limits: Existing latchwing family only: latchwing class 15 CYBR telegraphed locked-direction dash, or relay_choir class 16 PAIN anchored slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, actor ID or mechanics. Codex owns behavior, labels and native frame mapping.

vertical_behavior_proposal.proposal: Proposed only, not implemented: step down one storey of planter shelves and refuse drops above two storeys. It cannot climb polished glass or jump gaps. Requires new ledge query and landing checks.
requires: new navigation/ledge queries
new lift state handling where named
vertical projectile/line-of-fire checks where named
Codex review before any gameplay claim

relay_choir.name: HOLLOW NURSE
relay_choir.description: A rooted hanging pod cluster around a pale vertical stalk. Three fungal bells hang from the crown, and the central bell carries a blank, almost-human face-shaped hollow. It does not walk; it turns in its root socket and breathes a slow three-part spore fan.
relay_choir.variant_a: Three separate hanging bells around a narrow blank central pod.
relay_choir.variant_b: One broad central bell with two smaller side pods and a curtain of root tendrils over the face hollow.
relay_choir.tells: The three bells inflate, their slits open and a pale glow rises inside the central hollow; loose spores gather at the rims.
relay_choir.counterplay: Anchored and slow to reorient. Fight from an angle, use a pillar to break the fan, and leave before the bells fully inflate if possible.
relay_choir.warning_notes: The three bells inflate, their slits open and a pale glow rises inside the central hollow; loose spores gather at the rims.
relay_choir.limits: Existing relay_choir family only: latchwing class 15 CYBR telegraphed locked-direction dash, or relay_choir class 16 PAIN anchored slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, actor ID or mechanics. Codex owns behavior, labels and native frame mapping.

vertical_behavior_proposal.proposal: Proposed only, not implemented: the spore fan could drift downward through a floor opening. That needs volumetric projectile handling; the first pass keeps the fan on one level.
requires: new navigation/ledge queries
new lift state handling where named
vertical projectile/line-of-fire checks where named
Codex review before any gameplay claim

latchwing.name: NIGHT PORTER
latchwing.description: A tall bellhop silhouette assembled from hotel service: a long maroon coat split into two stiff coat-tail legs, a brass-buttoned torso, a suitcase forearm and a peaked cap pulled over a blank face. It stands too upright and leans in only when it has decided.
latchwing.variant_a: One suitcase forearm, two coat-tail legs and a straight peaked cap.
latchwing.variant_b: Two cases at different heights, a longer split coat and a tilted cap with a brass bell badge.
latchwing.tells: The cap tilts, the suitcase seam opens on a dark gap and the coat tails lock together. Amber light gathers under the case before the lunge.
latchwing.counterplay: The porter commits to a straight service-corridor dash. Sidestep through a door bay or around a luggage winch; it cannot turn mid-run.
latchwing.warning_notes: The cap tilts, the suitcase seam opens on a dark gap and the coat tails lock together. Amber light gathers under the case before the lunge.
latchwing.limits: Existing latchwing family only: latchwing class 15 CYBR telegraphed locked-direction dash, or relay_choir class 16 PAIN anchored slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, actor ID or mechanics. Codex owns behavior, labels and native frame mapping.

vertical_behavior_proposal.proposal: Proposed only, not implemented: use the service lift as a same-shaft chase, waiting for the car instead of teleporting. It cannot climb the outside of the lift or cross the atrium void. New lift-state AI and navigation links would be required.
requires: new navigation/ledge queries
new lift state handling where named
vertical projectile/line-of-fire checks where named

relay_choir.name: CALL-BELL CHOIR
relay_choir.description: An anchored luggage trolley fused with three brass call bells and a tall room-number paddle. Amber bulbs sit under the bells; the trolley shudders and rings a slow three-part fan of resonance instead of moving. The wheels twitch but never roll.
relay_choir.variant_a: Low luggage cart with three bells in a row and one upright paddle.
relay_choir.variant_b: Tall stacked luggage with three bells at different heights and a bent, split paddle.
relay_choir.tells: One bell after another rises on its stalk, the three amber bulbs brighten and the paddle turns to face the player before the fan.
relay_choir.counterplay: Anchored, slow to track and blocked by the central shaft corner. Break the line of the three bells, then close from the side.
relay_choir.warning_notes: One bell after another rises on its stalk, the three amber bulbs brighten and the paddle turns to face the player before the fan.
relay_choir.limits: Existing relay_choir family only: latchwing class 15 CYBR telegraphed locked-direction dash, or relay_choir class 16 PAIN anchored slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, actor ID or mechanics. Codex owns behavior, labels and native frame mapping.
